# RecDiffy.NET profiles: consolidation

> Consolidation runs on each side after normalization and before matching, and is optional. lifecycle collapses each chain of cancels (CANC) and corrections (CORR) into the one row that survives; the rows it replaced are suppressed, not dropped. packages merges the linked legs of one trade into a single item. Up: https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/profiles/llms.txt

## Reference

- [Consolidation: lifecycles and packages](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/consolidation-lifecycles-and-packages.md): both blocks, with every key and default
- [Lifecycle](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/lifecycle.md): action, target, scope and corrTarget; chains, survivors and the quarantine codes
- [Packages](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/packages.md): link, role, requiredRoles, and the Same, Sum, FromRole and DifferenceByRole aggregators
- [Consolidation, worked](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/readme/consolidation.md): a broker's NEW, CANC and CORR rows collapsing to one survivor, with the profile and output
- [Suppression in the result](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/results/suppression.md): Superseded, CancelEvent and FullyCancelled

## Examples

- [A lifecycle chain](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profile-examples/a-lifecycle-chain.md): a chain and the dispositions it gives
- [Trade events](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/result-examples/trade-events.md): real output for lifecycle chains
- [ProfileBuilder](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/builders/profilebuilder.md): Lifecycle(side) and Packages(side, PackageBuilder) in code
